title: Deutsche's Saravelos to 'Keep Writing' After US Ire
text: Deutsche Bank's global head of FX research George Saravelos, who wrote a report that became the subject of US ire, says the episode "really reaffirmed the importance of research independence." Last month, Saravelos warned US President Donald Trump’s threats over Greenland may prompt Europe to become less willing to hold US assets. Days later, Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said that the German bank’s CEO had called to dismiss the report. Saravelos speaks on Bloomberg Television. (Source: Bloomberg)
